item.title: Sony halts memory card shipments due to NAND shortage
item.description:
📝 Sony is currently unable to fulfill orders for CFexpress Type A, CFexpress Type B, and SDXC/SDHC memory cards. That type of NAND has become scarce. Micron Preceded Sony By withdrawing from this consumer supply, Sony is choosing a familiar path.
🔗 Read more: https://www.techzine.eu/news/devices/140058/sony-halts-memory-card-shipments-due-to-nand-shortage/
